homes_desc:
**Import Home Devices**

After binding, all smart devices under the selected homes will be added.

**Room Name Sync Rules**

When syncing devices to Home Assistant, device area names follow these rules (this will NOT change your Haier Smart Home APP settings):

• No sync: Devices will not be assigned to any area

• Sync mode: Uses home name and/or room name from Haier Smart Home APP as HA area name

room_sync_options.family_and_room: Home name and room name (My Home / 1F / Bedroom)

oauth_page_success_desc: Haier Smart Home authorization is complete. Please close this page and return to Home Assistant to continue setup.
oauth_page_fail_expired: The authorization session has expired or is invalid.
